missing: DataView does not display the auto-extraction history-write warning stored in record.note when record.status is ok.
When an extraction failure and history-write failure happen together in PatternsTab or DataView, the second error message replaces the extraction reason.

findings.finding: Auto-extraction records a successful row result with a history-write failure in note, but DataView's status=ok branch always renders the fixed success text and never renders note. The metadata failure is silent to the person even though rows remain visible.
findings.required_fix: Show the saved-history warning in the successful auto result without discarding rows; add a connected assertion that reads the rendered DataView.

findings.finding: When both extraction and history write fail, setRunError is called twice and the history message drops the extraction error. The failed focused test's rendered DOM showed only the history message and omitted 'Selector could not execute'.
findings.required_fix: Keep the extraction reason and distinguish the history-write error in the same visible result; guard both callers.

findings.finding: The new history-failure test installs mocks.bumpRun.mockResolvedValue('Database unavailable'), while afterEach calls vi.clearAllMocks(), which preserves mock implementation. A later existing test inherits the failure and the final four-file suite is red.
findings.required_fix: Reset the mock implementation between tests and rerun the four exact focused files.

verdict_b.shared_query_assessment: bumpPatternRun now awaits UPDATE ... select('id').maybeSingle(), distinguishes a returned PostgREST error and a zero-row result, and reports thrown exceptions. This is an appropriate detection shape for an RLS-filtered UPDATE; no live RLS or persisted-write proof was performed in this lane.
verdict_b.forcing_test_assessment: The Showcase ordering test uses a pending metadata promise and distinct old/new persisted timestamps, so an early refresh should fail. A temporary red mutation was not run. The auto-warning visibility and dual-failure cases have no forcing UI assertions.
